feature_blocks.implementation_notes: Six bands for each of eight channels; the frontal multiplier is added in log space to channels 1-4.

feature_blocks.formula: mean_{f in band} P_c(f) / mean_{0.5<=f<55} P_c(f)
feature_blocks.implementation_notes: Six bands per channel; channels 1-4 are multiplied by 1.12 and theta/alpha entries by 1.10.
Computed per channel over the implemented 0.5-55 Hz mask.
Two ratios for each channel using relative powers after the fixed multipliers.
Four summaries per channel after within-window z-score; mean, standard deviation and RMS are therefore nearly fixed by construction.

feature_blocks.formula: mean_c(relative); std_c(relative); mean_c(log absolute); mean_c(entropy); std_c(entropy)
feature_blocks.implementation_notes: Six values for each of the first three summaries plus two entropy summaries.
Activity, mobility and complexity for each channel.
The one-dimensional alpha term is a channel-group contrast, not a standard left-right frontal alpha asymmetry measure.
The first four ordered channels are Fp1, Fp2, F7 and F3.
Six FFT-mask reconstructed band signals for each of eight channels.
One channel-mean differential-entropy value per band.

important_corrections.alpha_term: channel-group alpha contrast; not standard left-right FAA
important_corrections.fft: 4096-point zero-padded FFT for 2125 samples; not 2048 points
important_corrections.online_scope: offline or delayed completed-window batch inference only

preprocessing_steps.exact_implementation: Detect modulo-256 packet counter in column 0; retain columns 1-8 only.
preprocessing_steps.limitation_or_interpretation: Exactly eight finite EEG columns are required; the parser refuses to guess when extra columns are ambiguous.
preprocessing_steps.purpose: Exclude packet counter, accelerometer, marker, status and other auxiliary columns.

preprocessing_steps.exact_implementation: Fourth-order Butterworth 0.5-55 Hz, applied with forward-backward sosfiltfilt before windowing.
preprocessing_steps.limitation_or_interpretation: Forward-backward filtering is zero-phase but non-causal; this is an offline analysis pipeline.
preprocessing_steps.purpose: Suppress drift and frequencies above the engineered feature range.

preprocessing_steps.exact_implementation: 8.5 s (2125 samples) with 0.5 s (125 samples) stride.
preprocessing_steps.limitation_or_interpretation: Adjacent windows share 94.12% of raw samples and must never be randomly separated across training and validation.
preprocessing_steps.purpose: Obtain stable spectral estimates from each completed window.

preprocessing_steps.limitation_or_interpretation: Uses the complete 8.5-s window. It is valid for completed-window offline/batch inference, not causal sample-by-sample prediction.
preprocessing_steps.purpose: Reduce amplitude and impedance-scale differences before feature extraction.

preprocessing_steps.exact_implementation: Apply a 2125-point Hann window and zero-pad to a 4096-point real FFT.
preprocessing_steps.limitation_or_interpretation: The implementation does not use a 2048-point FFT. Zero-padding refines the frequency grid but does not add physical frequency resolution.
preprocessing_steps.purpose: Reduce spectral leakage and provide a convenient frequency grid.

preprocessing_steps.exact_implementation: Multiply FFT power bins from 48.5 through 51.5 Hz by 0.03.
preprocessing_steps.limitation_or_interpretation: This is not a designed time-domain notch filter. The value 0.03 is an inherited heuristic, not a learned or theoretically guaranteed constant.
preprocessing_steps.purpose: Heuristically suppress mains-frequency contamination in spectral features.

preprocessing_steps.exact_implementation: Multiply all relative band powers in Fp1/Fp2/F7/F3 by 1.12; multiply theta and alpha relative powers in every channel by 1.10.
preprocessing_steps.limitation_or_interpretation: The values 1.12 and 1.10 were not selected inside the v3 nested protocol and must not be presented as optimized or physiologically validated constants.
preprocessing_steps.purpose: Inherited heuristic emphasis of frontal and workload-related spectral terms.

preprocessing_steps.exact_implementation: C = X X^T / 2125 + 1e-4 I for each standardized 8-channel window.
preprocessing_steps.limitation_or_interpretation: The covariance matrix is not part of the 272-dimensional flat feature vector. An 8-channel tangent vector has 8*9/2=36 dimensions, not 253.
preprocessing_steps.purpose: Provide a separate symmetric positive-definite representation for MDM and tangent-space baselines.

preprocessing_steps.exact_implementation: Fourth-order zero-phase 0.5-45 Hz band-pass followed by the same within-window per-channel z-score.
preprocessing_steps.limitation_or_interpretation: Its upper cutoff differs from the 55-Hz engineered-feature path. This must be disclosed as a representation-specific preprocessing difference, not described as an identical front end.
preprocessing_steps.purpose: Provide standard bandwidth-limited raw input for EEGNet and EEG-Conformer.
